title: Docs Viewer Roadmap
content_html:
Docs Viewer Roadmap

suggested order feature status depends on outcome
1 Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model shipped — establish source, build, published, location, and ownership contracts plus provider-independent workflows before further Docs Viewer work
2 Recent (doc archived) shipped — show recent additions for catalogue-like Moments and recent edits for changing document collections
3 External-Local Scope Media Layout (archived) shipped — keep ordinary external-local media in its configured published root and scope lifecycle
4 Scope Media Management proposed Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; External-Local Scope Media Layout; Source Editor Add Image And Add File expose and extend provider-independent inventory and lifecycle understanding for media already owned by each scope
5 Control Surfaces shipped — give controls a consistent definition, host, state, and action model
6 Local Tree Move Projection (doc archived) shipped Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model update the local index after a committed move without a full refresh
7 Source Editor Add Image And Add File shipped Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; Control Surfaces publish staged media into the active document, extract HTML-inline SVG through the same foundation, and retire standalone wrapper imports
8 Document Diagrams (archived) shipped Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; External-Local Scope Media Layout; Source Editor Add Image And Add File retain published SVG for static/public needs, extend accessible inline Mermaid across both managed local scope types, and provide one shared diagram detail control
9 Word Document Import (archived) shipped — accept staged .docx through Mammoth and the existing HTML import path without expanding the fidelity contract
10 Copy And Move Documents Between Scopes (archived) shipped Index Multiple Selection; Document Diagrams IMD-4 copy or move checked document sets and their referenced scope-owned media between writable non-public scopes
11 Button Placement shipped Control Surfaces place controls by the user's object of action and promote Open in VS Code to the document toolbar
12 Share Document Packages (archived) shipped — own document-package routes, modules, profiles, services, whole-package return, and canonical handoffs in integrated Docs Viewer; retire generic Data Sharing and tag-package workflows
13 Scope-First Storage Layout (archived) shipped Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; External-Local Scope Media Layout make each scope the provider-neutral ownership and lifecycle container with source and published roles beneath it while keeping public deployment destinations independent
14 Docs Viewer Core Refactor proposed Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; Share Document Packages; Scope-First Storage Layout; Analytics App Retirement extract an explicit core, make configuration and runtime dependencies composition-owned, and recompose the integrated application without changing product behavior
15 Standalone Docs Viewer proposed Docs Viewer Core Refactor; Scope-First Storage Layout package and release a self-contained external-local application as the first independent core consumer
16 Share Sub-Scope Documents paused Share Document Packages; explicit sub-scope source/write support share a configured sub-scope as a document corpus without recreating domain adapters or canonical-data apply paths
17 Index Multiple Selection (archived) shipped Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; Control Surfaces; Local Tree Move Projection retain the shipped checkbox lifecycle and Prepare package, Copy, Move, and Delete consumers; reopen further consumers only for a demonstrated need
18 Document Sharing UI Redesign (archived) shipped Share Document Packages; Index Multiple Selection host Prepare package and Review package as focused manage Actions, keep returned packages whole, and retire both duplicate browser routes without aliases
19 Docs Viewer Manage Theme Restoration shipped Document Sharing UI Redesign restore one complete light and dark theme contract across the manage route and current overlays
20 Docs Viewer Modal Consistency (archived) shipped Document Sharing UI Redesign; Docs Viewer Manage Theme Restoration give every current management modal one shared lifecycle and deliberate styling variants without changing domain workflows
21 Mermaid Authoring And Publication proposed Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; Docs Viewer Manage Theme Restoration make fenced Mermaid the preferred source for document-contained diagrams and materialize static light/dark variants for public readers
22 Public Docs Viewer Mobile Experience proposed — review and deliberately redesign public scope, index, navigation, and reading behaviour for actual mobile browsers
23 Semantic Reference Authoring paused Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model; Docs Viewer Core Refactor improve semantic-reference authoring when a bounded need becomes important
24 Dated Export Snapshots paused Docs Viewer Source And Publication Model retain small browseable snapshots outside Docs Viewer without creating an archive scope
